meta.title: Admin Panel User Guide
meta.subtitle: How to edit the website's texts, projects and logos, and follow up client messages — step by step

intro.text: The admin panel is where you change everything on the PuzzleX Media website without a developer. Whatever you save appears on the website straight away. The panel's screens are in Arabic: this guide shows every button with its **Arabic label** exactly as on screen, followed by what it means in English. Read **Getting started** first, then go to the chapter you need.

cards.title: One task per section
cards.text: Each heading is something you want to get done, like "Add a new project". Follow the steps in order.

cards.title: Pictures show where to click
cards.text: The letters on the screenshots (A, B, C…) point at the buttons. The list under each picture explains every letter.

cards.title: Nothing changes until you save
cards.text: You can try things safely: until you press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) the website stays as it is, and **تراجع** (Undo) throws your edits away.

cards.title: Reference pages at the back
cards.text: At the end: a one-page quick reference, common questions, fixes for problems, and a glossary.

chapters.title: Getting started
chapters.intro: Signing in, finding your way around, and saving your changes.

tasks.title: Sign in to the admin panel
tasks.goal: Every time you want to change something on the website.
before: An up-to-date browser on a computer or phone (Chrome, Safari or Edge)
steps: Open your browser, type `www.puzzlexmedia.com/admin` and press `Enter`.

steps.text: Type your username in [[user]] **اسم المستخدم** (Username) and your password in [[pass]] **كلمة المرور** (Password), then press [[go]] **دخول** (Sign in).

callouts.label: **اسم المستخدم** (Username) — in English letters, e.g. hussein. Capitals don't matter
**كلمة المرور** (Password) — shown as dots
**دخول** (Sign in)

steps.warning: After 8 wrong attempts within 15 minutes, sign-in pauses and the panel says *محاولات كثيرة — انتظر 15 دقيقة* (Too many attempts — wait 15 minutes). Wait, then try again.

tasks.result: The panel's home page opens with a greeting with your name, such as *مساء الخير، حسين* (Good evening, Hussein).
tasks.tip: Bookmark the panel's address in your browser so it's one click away.

tasks.title: Find your way around the panel
tasks.goal: A quick tour so you know where everything is.

callouts.label: The menu — moves you between the panel's sections
At a glance: new messages, number of projects and logos, edited texts
**عرض الموقع ↗** (View website) — opens the website in a new tab to see your changes
Who is signed in

steps.text: Use the menu on the right to move between sections. Each section has its own chapter in this guide.

callouts.label: **النصوص** (Texts) — every heading, paragraph and button on the website
**المشاريع** (Projects) — the Work page and each project's page
**شعارات الشركاء** (Partner logos) — the partners puzzle
**التواصل والروابط** (Contact & links) — phone, email, social accounts
**الرسائل** (Messages) — what visitors send through the contact form. Red number = unread
**حسابي** (My account) — change password, sign out

steps.text: Press any box in the summary to jump to its section. A red box [[unread]] means new messages are waiting.

callouts.label: Unread messages — press to open the inbox
Number of projects shown on the Work page

tasks.note: The panel works on phones too: the sections appear in a bar across the top that you swipe left and right.

tasks.title: Save your changes, or undo them
tasks.goal: This works the same in every part of the panel: make your edits, then save once.

steps.text: Change any field. Its border [[ar]] turns lime so you can see it changed and isn't saved yet.

callouts.label: A field that changed and isn't saved yet

steps.text: A bar appears at the bottom of the screen with the number of changes [[count]]. Press [[save]] **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).

callouts.label: Unsaved changes and the section's name
**حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) — publishes your changes
**تراجع** (Undo) — throws away everything since the last save

sub: Or press `Ctrl + S` on the keyboard (`⌘ + S` on a Mac).

steps: A message *تم الحفظ — التغييرات ظاهرة الآن على الموقع* (Saved — the changes are live on the website) appears at the top, and the bar disappears.
To throw your edits away instead: press **تراجع** (Undo), then confirm *تجاهل كل التغييرات غير المحفوظة؟* (Discard all unsaved changes?).
tasks.result: The bar at the bottom is gone. Open the website (or refresh its page) to see the change.
tasks.warning: If you go to another section or close the page before saving, the panel asks *لديك تغييرات غير محفوظة. المغادرة بدون حفظ؟* (You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?). Choose **Cancel** to go back and save.
tasks.note: If a colleague edits the same section and saves before you, you'll see *حفظ مستخدم آخر تغييرات هنا قبلك* (Another user saved changes here before you). Copy what you typed, refresh the page and enter it again — that way nobody's work is overwritten.

tasks.title: Change your password
tasks.goal: When you first sign in, or if you think someone else knows your password.
steps: Press **حسابي** (My account) in the menu.

steps.text: Type your current password in [[current]], the new one in [[new]], the new one again in [[again]], and press [[go]] **تغيير كلمة المرور** (Change password).

callouts.label: **كلمة المرور الحالية** (Current password)
**كلمة المرور الجديدة** (New password) — at least 10 characters
**تأكيد كلمة المرور الجديدة** (Confirm new password) — exactly the same
**تغيير كلمة المرور** (Change password)

tasks.result: A message confirms the change and says your other sessions were signed out: any other device you were signed in on now asks for the new password.
tasks.tip: A long phrase you can remember (like *morning-coffee-by-the-sea*) is stronger and easier than a short complicated word. Don't reuse your email password.

tasks.title: Sign out
tasks.goal: When you're done, especially on a computer other people use.
steps: Press **حسابي** (My account) in the menu.

steps.text: Press [[out]] **تسجيل الخروج** (Sign out) at the bottom of the page.

callouts.label: **تسجيل الخروج** (Sign out)

tasks.note: If the panel is left unused for 12 hours you're signed out automatically and asked to sign in again.

chapters.title: Texts
chapters.intro: Every text on the website — headings, paragraphs, buttons and page titles — in Arabic and English side by side.

tasks.title: Find the text you want to change
tasks.goal: Before any edit: find the text by page or by searching.

callouts.label: Search every text
Pages — pick one to see only its texts
**افتح الصفحة ↗** (Open page) — opens the chosen page on the website to compare

steps: Press **النصوص** (Texts) in the menu.

steps.text: Pick the page with the buttons [[page]], or type a few words of the text in the search box [[search]]. Search works in Arabic and English, across all pages.

callouts.label: Type part of the text you see on the website
The page shown now (lime). The number is how many texts it has
**مشترك بين الصفحات** (Shared) — texts on several pages, like the menu and footer
**المعدّلة فقط** (Edited only) — shows what has been changed

tasks.tip: Can't find a text under its page? Search for it: texts that appear on several pages live under **مشترك بين الصفحات** (Shared).
tasks.note: Two more groups: **عناوين الصفحات ووصف المشاركة** (Page titles & share descriptions — what Google and link previews show), and **الرسوم المتحركة والتفاعلات** (Animations & interactions — words inside the home page animations and form messages).

tasks.title: Edit a text in Arabic and English
tasks.goal: Change a heading, a paragraph or the words on a button.

steps.text: In the text's card, type the new Arabic in [[ar]] **العربية** (Arabic) and the English in [[en]] **English**.

callouts.label: What kind of text: heading, paragraph, button…
The pages it appears on
**العربية** (Arabic) — the text on the Arabic website
**English** — the same text on the English website

sub: Changing only one language? Leave the other as it is.

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) in the bar at the bottom.
Press **عرض الموقع ↗** (View website) and check the text looks right. If the page was already open, refresh it (`F5`).
tasks.result: The new text is on the website, and its card in the panel shows the tag **معدّل** (Edited).
tasks.warning: Shared texts (like **من نحن** — About, in the menu) change on every page at once. That's intended.
tasks.tip: Keep roughly the original length, especially for big headings and buttons, so lines don't break awkwardly on phones.

tasks.title: Put a text back to the original
tasks.goal: If you don't like an earlier edit and want the original wording back.
steps: Press **المعدّلة فقط** (Edited only) to see every text that was changed.

steps.text: In the text's card, press [[restore]] **استرجاع الأصل** (Restore original). The original text comes back in both boxes.

callouts.label: **معدّل** (Edited) — this text differs from the original
**استرجاع الأصل** (Restore original)
**الأصل:** (Original) — the original Arabic and English, to compare

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The **معدّل** (Edited) tag disappears and the website shows the original text again.
tasks.note: Emptying a box completely and saving does the same: an empty box means "use the original".

tasks.title: Edit a page's title and its Google / share description
tasks.goal: The text in the browser tab, in Google results, and in the preview when someone sends a link on WhatsApp or Facebook.
steps: In **النصوص** (Texts), press **عناوين الصفحات ووصف المشاركة** (Page titles & share descriptions).

steps.text: Each card says where it's used [[kind]], e.g. *وصف الصفحة في محركات البحث* (Description in search engines) or *عنوان المشاركة* (Share title). Edit the text [[ar]] and save.

callouts.label: Where this text is shown
The Arabic text

tasks.tip: Keep descriptions to one or two sentences (about 160 characters) saying what the company offers. Google cuts longer ones.
tasks.note: WhatsApp and Facebook keep an old preview for a while, so a new description may take time to show up when sharing.

chapters.title: Projects
chapters.intro: The projects on the Work page. Each project also has its own page with photos and a description.

tasks.title: Change the order of projects on the Work page
tasks.goal: Bring the most important or newest projects to the top.

callouts.label: **+ مشروع جديد** (New project)
**افتح صفحة الأعمال ↗** (Open Work page) — see the order on the website
A project — in the same order as on the website

steps: Press **المشاريع** (Projects) in the menu.

steps.text: Press [[up]] **↑** to move a project up one place, or [[down]] **↓** to move it down. Repeat until it's where you want it.

callouts.label: Cover photo (or the logo if there's no cover yet)
**↑** Move up
**↓** Move down
**تعديل** (Edit) — opens the project

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The project shows in its new place on the Work page; the previous/next links between projects follow the same order.

tasks.title: Edit a project's texts
tasks.goal: Correct the client's name, the title, the description or the services.

callouts.label: **→ كل المشاريع** (All projects) — back to the list
**عرض على الموقع ↗** (View on website)
**حذف المشروع** (Delete project)

steps: In **المشاريع** (Projects), press **تعديل** (Edit) next to the project.

steps.text: Change what you need in the **النصوص** (Texts) card. Every field has two boxes: **بالعربية** (Arabic) and **English**.

callouts.label: **اسم العميل** (Client name) — shown above the title
**عنوان المشروع** (Project title)
**وصف المشروع** (Description) — on the project page and in link previews
**الخدمات المقدّمة** (Services) — separate them with commas

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The project changes on the Work page, on its own page, in the browser tab title and in link previews.
tasks.note: Fields with a star (*) need the Arabic. If the English is left empty, the Arabic shows on the English website.

tasks.title: Add a new project
tasks.goal: When you finish new work for a client and want to show it on the Work page.
before: Client name and project title in Arabic and English
A cover photo and gallery photos (optional) — JPG or PNG
steps: In **المشاريع** (Projects), press **+ مشروع جديد** (New project). An empty project is added at the top of the list and opens.

steps.text: Fill in [[client]] **اسم العميل** (Client name) and [[title]] **عنوان المشروع** (Project title) in Arabic and English, then the description and services.

callouts.label: **اسم العميل** (Client name) — Arabic required (*)
**عنوان المشروع** (Project title) — Arabic required (*)

steps.text: In the **التصنيف** (Category) card, pick the **القطاع** (Sector) and the year. Notice [[link]] **اسم الرابط** (Link name): it's filled in from the English name and title, and [[address]] shows the project page's address.

callouts.label: **اسم الرابط (بالإنجليزية)** (Link name) — lowercase English letters, numbers and - only
The project page's address on the website

steps: Add the logo, cover photo and gallery photos — see the next tasks.
Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The project appears first on the Work page, under the sector you picked, and in the sitemap for search engines.
tasks.warning: Avoid changing the **اسم الرابط** (Link name) of an existing project: links people shared earlier stop working.
tasks.tip: Without a cover photo, the project shows a placeholder cover in its colours with its logo. Pick the two colours in the **ألوان الغلاف المؤقت** (Placeholder colours) card at the bottom.

tasks.title: Upload a cover photo
tasks.goal: The photo on the project's card on the Work page.
steps: Open the project (**تعديل** — Edit) and scroll to the **صورة الغلاف** (Cover photo) card.
Press **رفع صورة الغلاف** (Upload cover photo) and pick the photo, or drag it from a folder onto the dashed box.

steps.text: A message says the photo is uploading, then it appears [[img]]. To replace it, press [[remove]] **إزالة** (Remove) and upload another.

callouts.label: The cover photo after uploading
**إزالة** (Remove) — goes back to the placeholder cover

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The photo shows on the project's card on the Work page.
tasks.tip: Best cover: a landscape photo with the important part in the middle — the edges are trimmed a little to fill the card. The panel shrinks big photos automatically before uploading, so don't resize them yourself.
tasks.note: Accepted: JPG, PNG and WebP, up to 8 MB per photo.

tasks.title: Add and arrange a project's gallery photos
tasks.goal: The large photos on the project's own page.
steps: Open the project and scroll to the **معرض الصور** (Gallery) card.

steps.text: Press [[add]] **إضافة صور** (Add photos) and pick one or more photos (or drag them onto the box). They upload one after another.

callouts.label: The first photo — shown wide at the top of the page
**→** Move earlier
**✕** Remove from the gallery
**←** Move later
**إضافة صور** (Add photos)

steps: Arrange them with the **→** and **←** arrows. The panel reads right to left: the first photo is on the right. On the page it's shown wide, then two side by side, then wide again, and so on.
Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The photos appear on the project page in the order you chose.
tasks.note: Until a project has real photos, its page shows placeholder images in its colours with its logo.

tasks.title: Choose the client's logo
tasks.goal: The logo on the project page and on the placeholder cover.

steps.text: In the **الشعار** (Logo) card, press [[pick]] **اختيار من شعارات الشركاء** (Choose from partner logos) if the client's logo is already in the partners puzzle, or [[upload]] **رفع شعار جديد** (Upload new logo) to upload a file.

callouts.label: The current logo
**اختيار من شعارات الشركاء** (Choose from partner logos)
**رفع شعار جديد** (Upload new logo)

steps.text: In the window, press the logo you want [[grid]]. The window closes and the logo appears in the card. To close without choosing, press **إغلاق** (Close) at the bottom.

callouts.label: Press any logo to choose it

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The new logo shows on the project page.

tasks.title: Delete a project
tasks.goal: Remove a project you no longer want to show.
steps: Open the project (**تعديل** — Edit).
Press **حذف المشروع** (Delete project) at the top, then confirm the message asking whether to delete it (you can still undo before saving).
You're back in the project list without it. Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) to complete the deletion — or **تراجع** (Undo) if you changed your mind.
tasks.result: The project disappears from the Work page, and its page link shows *Project not found*.
tasks.danger: After **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) a deleted project can't be brought back from the panel. If you might want it again, copy its texts somewhere first.

tasks.title: Rename the sectors
tasks.goal: The filter buttons at the top of the Work page (e.g. *International & development*) and the sector shown on each project page.
steps: In **المشاريع** (Projects), scroll to the **أسماء القطاعات** (Sector names) card.

steps.text: Change the Arabic [[ar]] and English names, then press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).

callouts.label: The sector's Arabic name

tasks.note: There are always three sectors; you can rename them but not add more. To move a project to another sector, change **القطاع** (Sector) on the project's page.

chapters.title: Partner logos
chapters.intro: The logos that come together in the "Partners in success" puzzle on the home page.

tasks.title: Add new logos
tasks.goal: When you start working with a new client whose logo you want to show.
before: The logo file — ideally a PNG with a transparent background

callouts.label: Number of logos and the current puzzle size
A logo — in the order it goes into the puzzle
**افتح الصفحة الرئيسية ↗** (Open home page) — see the puzzle

steps: Press **شعارات الشركاء** (Partner logos) in the menu and scroll to the end of the page.

steps.text: Press [[add]] **إضافة شعارات** (Add logos) and pick one or more files, or drag them onto the box.

callouts.label: **إضافة شعارات** (Add logos)

steps: Each logo appears at the end of the list with its file name as its name. Correct the name if needed.
Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The logo appears in the "Partners in success" puzzle on the home page.
tasks.tip: The puzzle resizes itself: up to 24 logos → 5×5, up to 48 → 7×7, up to 80 → 9×9. Any pieces without a logo show as plain white.
tasks.note: Each logo sits on a white piece, so an all-white logo won't show — use the coloured or dark version.

tasks.title: Name and arrange the logos
tasks.goal: Bring the most important partners forward and give each its name.

steps.text: In the logo's card, type the partner's name in [[name]]. Use [[earlier]] **→** to move it earlier and [[later]] **←** to move it later.

callouts.label: Its position
**اسم الشريك (اختياري)** (Partner name, optional) — shown when the mouse is over the logo in the puzzle
**→** Move earlier
**✕** Remove
**←** Move later

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The logos appear in the new order in the puzzle, and a partner's name shows when the mouse is over its logo.

tasks.title: Remove a logo
tasks.goal: Take a partner's logo out of the puzzle.
steps: Press **✕** in the logo's card. It disappears from the list straight away.
Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The logo is gone from the puzzle and the rest come together again.
tasks.warning: If a project uses this logo, it stays on that project's page. Change the project's logo there if needed.

chapters.title: Contact & links
chapters.intro: Phone numbers, email and social accounts. They appear in every page's footer and on the Contact page.

tasks.title: Add the phone, WhatsApp and email
tasks.goal: So visitors can call or message you with one tap.
steps: Press **التواصل والروابط** (Contact & links) in the menu.

steps.text: Type the number in [[phone]] **رقم الهاتف** (Phone) and the WhatsApp number in [[wa]] **رقم واتساب** (WhatsApp), with the country code (e.g. `+971 50 123 4567`), and the email in [[email]].

callouts.label: **رقم الهاتف** (Phone) — starts with + and the country code
**رقم واتساب** (WhatsApp) — the WhatsApp button opens a chat directly
**البريد الإلكتروني** (Email)
**الموقع** (Website) — your website address

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The numbers and email appear on the Contact page and in every page's footer, all tappable.
tasks.tip: Open the Contact page on your phone and tap **واتساب** (WhatsApp) to check it opens a chat with the right number.

tasks.title: Add links to your social media accounts
tasks.goal: LinkedIn, Instagram, X and Facebook links on the website.
steps: Open your account on that platform in the browser and copy the address from the address bar.

steps.text: Paste it in its box, e.g. [[li]] **LinkedIn**. It must start with `https://`.

callouts.label: **LinkedIn** — e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/…
An empty box — that detail or icon doesn't appear on the website

steps: Press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes).
tasks.result: The social icons in the website's footer and on the Contact page work and open the account in a new tab.

tasks.title: Check the result on the website
tasks.goal: After every change to the contact details.
steps: Press **افتح صفحة التواصل ↗** (Open Contact page) at the top.

steps.text: Check the number [[phone]], that the [[wa]] **واتساب** (WhatsApp) button works, and that the social icons [[socials]] open the right pages.

callouts.label: The number — tap it to call
**واتساب** (WhatsApp) button
Social icons

tasks.note: To hide any detail or link: empty its box and save. It disappears from the website.

chapters.title: Messages
chapters.intro: Every message a visitor sends from the "Contact us" form arrives here, newest first.

tasks.title: Read new messages
tasks.goal: Follow up new client requests every day.

callouts.label: Number of unread messages
**الكل** (All) / **غير المقروءة** (Unread)
A new message — lime dot and name in bold
A message already read

steps: Press **الرسائل** (Messages) in the menu. The red number next to it is how many are new.
Press **غير المقروءة** (Unread) to see only the new ones.
Press the sender's name to open the message. It's marked as read automatically.
tasks.result: The lime dot disappears and the red number goes down.

tasks.title: Reply to a message, or delete it
tasks.goal: After reading a client's request.

steps.text: An open message shows the sender's email [[email]], phone and company, the services they picked [[services]], then their message.

callouts.label: Email — press it to write to them
**القطع المطلوبة** (Requested services) — what they picked in the form
**رد بالبريد** (Reply by email)
**تعليم كغير مقروءة** (Mark as unread) — to come back to it
**حذف** (Delete) — permanently

steps: Press **رد بالبريد** (Reply by email). Your email program opens with a message to the client ready to write.
To remember to come back to it, press **تعليم كغير مقروءة** (Mark as unread).
To delete a message (spam, for example), press **حذف** (Delete) and confirm.
tasks.danger: A deleted message can't be brought back. Only delete messages you no longer need.
tasks.note: The form blocks automated spam and accepts at most 5 messages from the same visitor every 10 minutes.

quick_reference.how: Open the message → **رد بالبريد** (Reply by email)
**حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) in the bottom bar, or `Ctrl + S`
**النصوص** (Texts) → pick the page or search → type → **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes)
**النصوص** → **عناوين الصفحات ووصف المشاركة** (Page titles & share descriptions)
**المشاريع** (Projects) → **+ مشروع جديد** (New project) → fill in → save

faq.q: When does my change appear on the website?
faq.a: As soon as you press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes). If the website page is already open, refresh it (`F5`).

faq.q: I saved a wrong text by mistake. Can I undo it?
faq.a: Yes. In **النصوص** (Texts) press **المعدّلة فقط** (Edited only), then **استرجاع الأصل** (Restore original) on the text, then save.

faq.q: Can my colleague and I work in the panel at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. If your colleague saves the same section before you, you'll see a message that another user saved first. Copy what you typed, refresh the page, enter it again and save — nobody's work gets overwritten.

faq.q: Can I use the panel on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. The sections show in a bar across the top that you swipe. Uploading photos from the phone (camera or gallery) works too.
Upload them as they are: the panel shrinks them and converts them to a lighter format automatically. They just need to be sharp, JPG, PNG or WebP, and under 8 MB.

faq.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faq.a: Ask your colleague or your technical contact to reset it. You'll get a new password; change it in **حسابي** (My account) after signing in.

faq.q: Why doesn't my change show in the WhatsApp link preview?
faq.a: WhatsApp and Facebook keep the old preview for a while. The website itself changes straight away; the preview catches up later.

faq.q: Do new messages arrive by email too?
faq.a: The panel always keeps every message. Sending a copy by email needs a one-time setup by your technical contact.

faq.q: Why does Arabic text show on the English website?
faq.a: Because the English box for that field is empty. Type the translation in the **English** box and save.

faq.q: Can we add a fourth project sector?
faq.a: Not from the panel: there are always three sectors, which you can rename. To add one, contact your technical contact.

troubleshooting.problem: *اسم المستخدم أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة* (Wrong username or password)
troubleshooting.cause: A typo, the keyboard set to Arabic, or Caps Lock on.
troubleshooting.fix: Switch the keyboard to English and type again carefully.

troubleshooting.problem: *محاولات كثيرة — انتظر 15 دقيقة* (Too many attempts — wait 15 minutes)
troubleshooting.fix: Wait 15 minutes, then try once, carefully.

troubleshooting.problem: *سجّل الدخول أولًا* (Sign in first), or the sign-in page appears suddenly
troubleshooting.cause: The session ended (12 hours unused), or the password was changed on another device.
troubleshooting.fix: Sign in again. Unsaved changes are lost — save as you go.

troubleshooting.problem: *حفظ مستخدم آخر تغييرات هنا قبلك…* (Another user saved here before you)
troubleshooting.cause: Your colleague saved the same section after you opened it.
troubleshooting.fix: Copy what you typed, refresh the page (`F5`), enter it again and save.

troubleshooting.problem: *الصور بصيغة JPG أو PNG أو WebP فقط* (Only JPG, PNG or WebP)
troubleshooting.cause: The file is another format (PDF, HEIC, SVG…).
troubleshooting.fix: Save the image as JPG or PNG, then upload. iPhone photos: export as JPG.
Export the image at lower quality or smaller size, then upload.

troubleshooting.problem: *… يجب أن يبدأ الرابط بـ* `https://` (Link must start with https://)
troubleshooting.cause: The link is incomplete or wrongly copied.
troubleshooting.fix: Copy the whole address from the browser's address bar, including `https://`.

troubleshooting.cause: A required field (*) is empty in one of the projects.
troubleshooting.fix: The message names the project number and field. Open it and fill in the Arabic.

troubleshooting.problem: *… اسم الرابط بحروف إنجليزية صغيرة…* (Link name: lowercase letters…) or *مستخدم لمشروع آخر* (used by another project)
troubleshooting.cause: The **اسم الرابط** (Link name) has spaces or Arabic letters, or is already taken.
troubleshooting.fix: Use only lowercase English letters, numbers and dashes, like `al-waha-bakery`, and a name not used yet.

troubleshooting.problem: *الهاتف: أرقام ومسافات و + ( ) - فقط* (Phone: digits only)
troubleshooting.cause: The number contains letters or other symbols.
troubleshooting.fix: Type digits only with the country code, like `+971 50 123 4567`.

troubleshooting.problem: Saved, but the website didn't change
troubleshooting.cause: The open website page is out of date.
troubleshooting.fix: Refresh the page (`F5`, or pull down on a phone).
Don't close the page: wait for the connection, then press **حفظ التغييرات** (Save changes) again.

glossary.definition: Your team's private site for editing the public website: `www.puzzlexmedia.com/admin`.
The button that publishes your edits. Nothing changes on the website before it.
Throws away everything since the last save; the website doesn't change.
A text that appears on several pages (like the menu links). Editing it once changes it everywhere.
Tag on a text that differs from the website's original wording.
Puts an edited text back to its original wording.
The title and description shown when the website's link is sent on WhatsApp or Facebook, and in Google results.
A project's category (International & development, Education & research, Brands) — the filter buttons on the Work page.
The English part of a project page's address, like `coffee-021` in `project.html?id=coffee-021`.
The project's photo on its card on the Work page.
The large photos on the project's own page.
A cover in the project's colours with its logo, shown automatically until real photos are uploaded.
The "Partners in success" section on the home page, where the logos come together as a puzzle.
A new message nobody has opened yet; it has a lime dot.
